checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); const ids=['board','victory','btn-undo','levels']; for (const id of ids) if (!html.includes('id=\"'+id+'\"')) process.exit(1); if (!html.includes('js/optics.js')||!html.includes('js/levels.js')||!html.includes('js/app.js')) process.exit(1); if (/https?:\/\//.test(html)) process.exit(1); console.log('html contract ok');"
checks.details: index.html wires local classic scripts, required element ids, and no remote URLs.

checks.details: No http(s) or CDN references in HTML, CSS, or JS.

summary: Lightweaver is a local Canvas 2D optical bench: deterministic ray tracing with mirrors, filters, splitters, prisms, walls, and sensors; five handcrafted labs including color mix, split/filter, prism dispersion, and a forbidden-sensor route; drag/rotate, undo, hints, and localStorage bests.
